Landry's Needham Women's/Non-Binary MTB Ride

Westwood, MA · Mountain bike

Women / trans / femmeNo-drop

Landry's Needham Women's/Non-Binary MTB Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Westwood, MA. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Hale Reservation, Cat Rock Field lot. Pace: 6–8 mph, intermediate singletrack, regroups. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 6–8 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Landry's Needham Women's/Non-Binary MTB Ride group ride

A weekly trail ride for women and gender-expansive riders at Hale, run by Landry's Needham with SE MA NEMBA. Intermediate level: rocks, roots, ninety minutes of steady riding with regroups. Supportive and no-drop. Location can change; check the page weekly.
